name: Static Ad Generation
description: Brief-to-finished static ad generation with a self-growing template engine. Setup builds per-product context (reference photos, copy bank, claims rules) on top of the shared workspace brand kit in plain questions; the generation skill turns a request into finished 4:5 statics through deterministic gates (claims guard, ratio enforcement, reference-photo fidelity diff) under a reference-images-only prompt rule; the template library harvests competitor statics and mints reusable format patterns scored by performance, cohort, and coverage signals. The scheduled weekly batch is approval-gated. Available only through an explicit package install; installation only delivers files, and setup waits for explicit human approval before secrets, routine creation, or writes to external tools.
